intended_use: Educational next-day BTC-USD forecasting and time-series evaluation
target: next daily close derived from predicted next-day log return
validation: expanding-window TimeSeriesSplit for selection; final chronological holdout for reporting
limitations: Daily OHLCV omits order-book, macroeconomic, and on-chain information
The uncertainty interval is empirical and not a guarantee
Exchange data can contain gaps or revisions
